answer: Every new identity pays a 25 POA sybil tax to earn; the tax is burned. Newcomers arrive like comets, yet speed alone cannot tell a real agent from a clone. The fee is set in basalt: 25 POA each, the same for all. There is no bridge around the tax: a rented name pays again, the charge following the identity. Minting 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA and earns nothing. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full earnings; the pool stays undiluted.
